assets/style.css.purpose: Whole site's CSS: design tokens, responsive nav, good/bad example blocks, checklist styling, light/dark mode, print stylesheet, logical (RTL-safe) properties. Turncount 10: unified header/main/footer to one shared --content-width (was misaligned at 60rem vs 42rem), added a decoupled --prose-width for flowing text, a --content-width-wide/.wrap-wide shell for the home page's card grid, real depth (shadow tokens, hover lift) on cards, and custom-drawn checklist checkboxes + a details/summary chevron replacing bare default widgets. Turncount 14: added the Craft component block -- course-meta/course-progress badge, lesson-progress-list + lesson-check states, lesson-nav, and the full quiz component (options, hover/disabled/correct/incorrect states, feedback panel) plus matching print rules. The course-progress badge's display rule is deliberately split into `.course-progress:not([hidden]) { display: inline-block; }` plus a separate unscoped properties block -- a plain `.course-progress { display: inline-block; ... }` has the same specificity as the UA stylesheet's `[hidden] { display: none }` and silently wins the tie, defeating the hidden attribute (caught via a real Playwright test, not by reading the CSS).

assets/print-details.js.purpose: Forces every page's collapsed 'Go deeper' <details> open for the duration of printing (beforeprint/afterprint listeners), then reverts. Added turncount 9 because this Chromium build does not auto-expand <details> for print -- verified via an actual rendered PDF, not assumed.

assets/craft-progress.js.purpose: Shared vanilla-JS helper for the Craft course system (added turncount 14). Reads/writes localStorage key craft-progress as {courseId: {lessonId: true}}. Wires up quiz click handling (disable all options, mark correct/incorrect, reveal feedback, record completion on any answer), renders per-lesson progress checks on course-overview pages, and renders/unhides the course-level completion badge. No accounts, no server -- client-side only by design.
